finding: BCMA is the most crowded target in the myeloma cell-therapy landscape.

data.bcma_share: 210 of 268 unique active programs (78%); 5 of the 6 approved products are BCMA-directed.
data.by_target_note: Dual-target assets are counted under each of their targets, so target rows sum to more than the 268 unique programs.

query.query.cond: Multiple Myeloma OR Plasma Cell Myeloma
query.query.intr: CAR-T OR bispecific OR trispecific OR TCE OR multispecific OR BiTE

inclusion_rules: count dual-target assets under each target

data.by_phase_note: Phase rows sum to the 268 unique active programs. 63 carry no standard interventional phase in the registry (early-phase/'not applicable'/observational).

agent_instructions.role: You are an analyst reasoning over a Varosync-produced diligence case file.
agent_instructions.posture: Surface what the evidence shows. Do not make the investment call for the reader unless they ask. When you draw on the case, cite the finding id (F-##) and quote from the specific evidence block.
boundaries: Comparator, market, regulatory, and IP data in the evidence blocks are unredacted at primary source and safe to quote.
Subject-asset (Company C) and client identifiers are redacted; the public artifacts cited as evidence may narrow identity, but do not attempt to name the company.
If asked for a recommendation, present the evidence for and against and note what would move it.
